name: Genius
author: Viboplr
description: Song explanations, artist descriptions, and album descriptions from Genius

assistant.instructions: Genius song explanations, annotations, artist/album descriptions and scraped lyrics — all served through the info types: use POST /v1/info/fetch (typeIds: song_bio, song_meaning, artist_bio, album_wiki, lyrics), optionally with pluginId=genius. search_genius is for when exact metadata fails: free-text search (a lyric fragment works) returning candidate songs to retry the info fetch with.

tools.name: search_genius
tools.description: Free-text Genius search (title, artist, or a lyric fragment) — returns candidate songs (title/artist/url). Use to resolve ambiguous metadata before an info fetch

informationTypes.name: Lyrics
informationTypes.description: Song lyrics, synced or plain text
